name: Drowned Cathedral
story: The tide has buried the old bells. Recover their silver from the drowned guardians.

name: Glassfire Caldera
story: The caldera still feeds an abandoned forge. Its keepers will not yield the crucible.

name: Winter Observatory
story: At the summit, the observatory counts stars that no longer exist.

name: Silverroot Abyss
story: Roots have swallowed the old road. Follow their silver veins beneath the earth.

name: Broken Constellation
story: Fragments of a fallen sky turn above an empty sanctuary.

name: Pale Dominion
story: Beyond the pale gates, the last court still guards its oath.

name: The Last Firmament
story: There are no roads beyond this citadel. Break its final seal.
